New plan: 

In my previous attempts, I analyzed the sequence of swaps and applied it to each scenario, but I didn't consider the specific initial conditions of each scenario. This led to incorrect conclusions. Next time, I will carefully examine the initial conditions of each scenario and take them into account when applying the sequence of swaps. For example, in Scenario 1, I should have noticed that the first swap between Claire and Alice would result in Claire having the yellow ball, not Alice. I will make sure to pay closer attention to the initial conditions and adjust my analysis accordingly.
